state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 3 (decode, and the cap) is in progress.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

The image component is embedded, typed into every compile and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). `info` and `run` are implemented. `run` decodes JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF and JPEG XL inside the guest and returns the RGBA8 pixels or the size, and refuses to encode JPEG XL. AVIF goes through `rav1d` on one thread with its asm off, plus a YUV-to-RGB conversion (`extensions/image/src/avif.rs` module doc). The cap is checked from the header first, and bytes that are no image and a malformed EXIF IFD return `parse` (`extensions/image/src/decode.rs` module doc). `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_decode.rs` pins all of it against the committed fixtures under `extensions/image/fixtures/`, and `every_first_wave_format_decodes_its_fixture` now passes.

A plan `step` is a WIT record with one optional field per operation, exactly one set (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`). `variants` is not declared yet.

**Not done:** the host does not pass `[image] max_pixels` in yet: the guest's cap is the call's `maxPixels`, or `"24M"`, and a call can raise it.

items.text: **The cap reaches the guest** (`rule:core-classes/image-pixel-cap`) — the host's call path at `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:565` sets the `Encoded` source's `maxPixels` of a built-in `Novis\Image\Codec::run` call to the smaller of the call's value and `nvs_config::image::in_force` (`crates/nvs-config/src/image.rs:59`). Put the clamp in `nvs_ext::builtin` as a pure function, so `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_decode.rs:151` can test it: `the_same_image_passes_when_the_cap_is_raised` and `a_call_may_lower_the_cap_and_never_raise_it`.

**The bomb case** — `tests/conformance/novis/image-a-bomb-is-refused-before-it-is-decoded.nvst` and `tests/conformance/novis/image-bytes-that-are-not-an-image-throw-a-parse-error.nvst`, beside `tests/conformance/novis/image-info-answers-with-no-configuration.nvst:1`. Each calls `Codec::run` with a `Source` array and a plan of `['steps' => [], 'overlays' => [], 'output' => Output::Raw]`, and catches `RuntimeError` or `ParseError`.

backlog: Turning off wasmtime's default features would remove zstd, ittapi and gdbjit C code from the binary; the ledger rows in `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts` `C_DEPENDENCIES` record them as unreachable meanwhile (`rule:packaging/a-c-dependency-answers-two-questions`).
libwebp's source pin was taken from the tarball as downloaded; Google publishes a `.asc` signature beside it that no tool checks yet (`tools/nv/cmd/webp-lib.ts`).
`info` reads `frames` as `1` and `exif` as `None`, and the cap counts one frame of an animated input (`extensions/image/src/info.rs`, `extensions/image/src/decode.rs` module docs).

A header whose buffer cannot fit in the 32-bit guest is refused with a message naming the cap but not the declared size, because the decoder refuses it before it reports one (`extensions/image/src/decode.rs`).
AVIF's conversion samples chroma at the nearest site and ignores the container's `irot`/`imir` and `colr` boxes; Stage 4's orientation and ICC items own those (`extensions/image/src/avif.rs`).
